meta.title: 다섯 개의 열쇠 / The Five Keys
meta.note: duration·aspect는 프롬프트 본문이 아니라 힉스필드 생성 파라미터로 설정

look.palette: dark oak + emerald velvet + antique gold; night corridor = cold blue moonlight with warm candle spots

wb.grand_foyer: 3000K candle chandelier + fading cool window light

look.grammar: Elara CU = eye-level (audience identification); Duke = low-angle silhouette (menace); key/door inserts = locked-off ECU; slow push-ins and holds; shallow DOF on all dialogue CUs; no on-screen text

screen_direction_lock.rule: EP01 전체 불변. OTS 왕복 시에도 유지.

shotlist.cam: slow push-in through open doors toward her
shotlist.audio: VO: Today, I became the Duke's sixth wife.

shotlist.cam: insert on ring, tilt up to their faces
shotlist.audio: VO: The five before me are all dead.

shotlist.cam: static two-shot, push to keys passing between hands
shotlist.audio: Marguerite: Keep them close, my lady — and never open the west wing doors.

shotlist.cam: slow lateral track following her past the five doors
shotlist.audio: VO: Five doors, five dead wives — and my keys fit every lock.

shotlist.cam: slow push-in as she leans to the door
shotlist.audio: Whisper behind the door, faint and female: Run.

shotlist.cam: she turns; hold on his silhouette down the corridor, slow advance
shotlist.dir: Kael frame-left far, Elara frame-right near
shotlist.audio: Kael: You were told not to come here.

shotlist.cam: locked OTS pair, eye-level on Elara, subtle low on Kael
shotlist.audio: E: How did your wives die, my lord? / K: ...Curiosity killed them.

shotlist.cam: hold on her face, whip focus to the door as knocking starts
shotlist.audio: Elara: Then I will die knowing. — then three slow knocks from inside the door.

shotlist.cam: slow drift on the first door's iron lock, key entering frame
shotlist.audio: VO: Next — the first door opens.
